lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Dienane Brandão de Mesquita | Lesson 24 -- A Trip to Brasilia
lesson.grammar_point: past simple questions (Did you...? / Where did you...?) and short answers (Yes, I did / No, I didn't)

listenings.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to our city tour of Brasilia. My name is Rodrigo, and I am your guide today. First, we will visit the Cathedral. It has a beautiful glass roof. Then we will see the Three Powers Square and the National Congress. At twelve, we will have lunch near the TV Tower. On weekends, there is a big market there, so you can buy a souvenir. Please stay with the group, and take many photos. Let's go!

Hi, Dienane, it is Carla! I saw your photos from Brasilia. They are beautiful! So, tell me everything. Did you like the city? Did you visit the Cathedral? Where did you stay? And did you buy a souvenir for me? I am only joking! Call me tonight, and tell me about the trip. Bye!

extra_audio.text: Marcos asks, where did you go last month? Dienane answers, I went to Brasilia. Marcos asks, did you take a city tour? Dienane answers, yes, I did, with a great guide. Then Marcos asks, did you buy a souvenir? Dienane answers, no, I didn't, but I took many photos.

reading.rtitle: HR News -- Five Questions About Brasilia
paras: Last month, Dienane went to Brasilia for a short vacation with her family. HR News asked her five questions.
Where did you stay? We stayed at a small hotel near the Monumental Axis. It was clean and quiet.
Did you take a city tour? Yes, we did. We took a tour with a guide on the first day. The guide was very friendly.
What did you see? We saw the Cathedral, the National Congress and the Three Powers Square. My favorite monument was the Cathedral.
Did you buy a souvenir? Yes, I did. I bought a small picture at the market near the TV Tower.
Did you like the food? No, I didn't love it. The food was good, but I missed the fish from Para!
